title: A computer glitch brought F1’s Malaysia race to a halt.
summary: After being idle on the throttle and letting the car slow, as is the norm on a formation lap, the software bug prevented the electrical power from kicking in. Esteban Ocon compared it to restarting Windows on a computer.
